blurb: With 20+ years of experience, we’ve been creating unforgettable parasailing adventures since 2012 in Grand Bend, Ontario. Soar above beautiful clear waters of Lake Huron and Grand Bend Beach with our skilled team, who bring 20+ years of expertise in parasailing and watersports. Safety, fun, and stunning views are our promise-your adventure starts
